name: JW Marriott Desert Springs Resort & Spa
positioning: Palm Desert resort built around Spa Desert Springs, a 38,000-square-foot spa with a hammam, sauna, steam room and outdoor saltwater lap pool
best_for: Couples looking for side-by-side spa treatments

facts.text: The resort is at 74-855 Country Club Drive in Palm Desert, California.
Spa Desert Springs spans 38,000 square feet.
Spa Desert Springs is inspired by the physical, historical and social environments of Palm Desert.
The spa has gender-separate and co-ed relaxation lounges, an Aromatic Hammam, a Finnish sauna and a Turkish steam room.
The spa suggests beginning a visit with hot-and-cold contrast hydrotherapy.
The full-service fitness center has Technogym strength and weight machines, cardio equipment, free weights and an 800-square-foot yoga and Pilates studio.
Regularly scheduled fitness classes and private training are available.
Fitness center access is complimentary for resort guests.
The Spa Bistro serves healthy cuisine including salads, smoothies, sandwiches and sushi, along with champagne and wine.
The Spa Shop carries brands including Priori, Lululemon, Kerstin Florian and Eminence Organic Skin Care.

highlights.text: The spa's Sanctuary Suite offers a private entrance, dedicated treatment rooms, a courtyard whirlpool and personalized service from a private butler.
The spa has an outdoor saltwater lap pool.
The Couples Revive experience features side-by-side massages, a mineral-laden bubble bath and champagne.
The spa's Spa Zone treatments are inspired by Blue Zone lifestyle principles to support longevity.

considerations.text: Spa Desert Springs requires an appointment.
The spa recommends arriving at least 30 minutes before an appointment to shower and prepare.
WhataHotel notes the desert location may feel remote for some travelers.
